_doc.how_to_use: Copy to results/m6/p2_spec.json after the W7 stop, delete this _doc object, fill, commit and freeze (evaluate_test.py --look T2 --print-frozen-candidates). T2 also requires a non_look ledger row with look_id W7_stop whose detail JSON has p2_spec_sha256 = the SHA-256 of the committed p2_spec.json. Static checks: check_p2_spec().
_doc.primary: The P2 method entering C4 (P2 - G*) and C5 (P2 - B6).
_doc.methods: H1, H2 and the P2 method(s). Score-file columns are H1, H2 (checked equal to the generic scores) and every method except a refitted one.
_doc.scores: test tier only: {path, sha256, layout} as in the P1 spec (line_gene test files under results/m6/tmp/).
_doc.failed_builds: test: null or {path, sha256} (ModelID, method), as in the P1 spec.
_doc.labels / genesets / universes / strata: P2's scalar tAP grid at T2 (subsets of the W1 grid; must include L_prob-or-primary, all, U, none).
_doc.b6: B6 for C5, refitted once on training ∪ validation inside the harness (§4.2) with the W1 feature set and stacking of scripts/w1_b6.py; hgb must equal W7's B6 settings nextgem.w7.HGB_M2 (max_iter 200, learning_rate 0.1, max_leaf_nodes 31, no early stopping; random_state = SEEDS[0]). T2 needs the primary label L_prob.
_doc.bootstrap_method: percentile or bca for C4/C5 (§6.5 skew rule on training).
_doc.fitted_on_labels: true when P2 is label-fitted (e.g. W7-05 = B6 with a monotone constraint on b2/b2m): P2 is then NOT read from the score file but refitted once on training ∪ validation through a reviewed refit recipe (see refit). false = P2 scores come from scores.test.
_doc.refit: Required iff fitted_on_labels is true: {recipe: 'w7_idea', idea: 'W7-01' | 'W7-05', method: <primary>}. The harness looks the idea up in nextgem.w7.IDEAS and runs w7.fit / w7.predict on training ∪ validation labels (a test line in the fit, or a predicted line among the fitting lines, is refused). Only ideas on the W1 B6 features qualify; others need their own reviewed recipe. The recipe code (src/nextgem/w7.py, scripts/w1_b6.py) must be pinned in provenance.

pipeline: EXAMPLE ONLY: W7-05 (B6 with a monotone increasing constraint on b2 and b2m), refitted on training ∪ validation.
